title: Random sampling variation

aliases.text: Biến thiên lấy mẫu ngẫu nhiên

provenance.sourceSection: §1.2 'Variation in Samples': two correctly drawn samples from the same population normally differ; sampling variability persists, distinct from sampling bias and self-selection in §1.2 'Critical Evaluation'

note: Source-checked distinction between ordinary chance-driven differences across samples and systematic distortion from recruitment/selection; not blanket academic lesson approval. A larger well-designed random sample may reduce random sampling error but cannot by itself repair selection bias.
